title: Leave

balances.title: Leave in {year}
balances.none: Your leave for this year hasn't been opened yet. Contact HR.

request.title: Request leave
request.documentHint: PDF, JPEG or PNG, up to 5 MB
request.documentRequired: This kind of leave needs a document, such as a medical certificate.
request.daysNote: Only working days count; weekends and public holidays don't.
request.sent: Leave request sent ({days} days). Your manager has been notified.
request.tooLarge: The file is larger than 5 MB.
request.wrongType: Use a PDF, JPEG or PNG file.
request.endBeforeStart: The end date can't be before the start date.

empty.approvals: Nothing is waiting for approval. Nice!

exportNeedsDates: Choose a date range before exporting.

approve.title: Approve {name}'s leave?
approve.description: {type} · {dates} · {days} days. The days are deducted and attendance is recorded as On leave.

reject.title: Reject {name}'s leave?
reject.description: {type} · {dates}. The employee will see your reason.

cancel.title: Cancel this leave request?
cancel.approvedNote: This request is approved: the days go back to the employee and future On-leave attendance is removed.

types.name: Name
types.caption: Leave types
types.codeHint: 2–30 English letters, digits or _, like MATERNITY
types.codeLocked: The code can't change after creation.

openYear.title: Open leave for {year}
openYear.description: Creates {year} balances for every current employee and every type that uses a balance. Unused annual leave carries over as the policy allows. Existing balances are left alone, so it is safe to run again (for example after new hires).
